LESSON: DANCE

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Dance

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Dance. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when dancing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use body movements that are part of daily experience in a variety of ways in dance for enjoyment,
2. use dance to express ideas to day activities related to dance feelings, and emotions for self- movements such as waving, swaying, expression, hand-shaking and digging in executing
3. use body zones and body parts dance movements appropriately in response to music,
4. apply locomotor and non- locomotor/axial movements imaginatively to create own dance, and non locomotor/axial movements in e) observe basic elements of dance in a dance performance for effective execution of dance, f) practice etiquette during dance performance for integrity, g) perform appropriate simple dances from diverse cultures for appreciation and enjoyment, h) appreciate and enjoy performing different cultural dances for cultural preservation, cultures for enjoyment 348 Property of the Government of Kenya i) use digital devices to learn and record various dances for digital literacy and enjoyment.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Dance.
2. Explain Dance to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Dance.
4. Show that you can: use body movements that are part of daily experience in a variety of ways in dance for enjoyment,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Dance. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: when dancing?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
